recipe: When a stakeholder provides vague or ambiguous requirements, go directly to the test suite to determine the actual expected behavior before writing implementation code.
trigger_condition: A non-technical stakeholder sends vague or poorly-specified requirements (e.g., a poorly written email) and it is unclear what the code should actually do.
evidence: Good thing we got some experience reading the tests because this email may as well have said "do work. thanks."
source_name: TypeHero: Advent of TypeScript 2023, Day Eight
